backbone: previously pinned Chronos-2, full275, float32, raw native median
training_origins: 192 onward, stride12, every target contained below cutoff
occupancy_features: 9 lags, mean/std last24 and last168, H native forecast outputs, sin/cos hour and week
duration_features: same 9 lags with extra1-hour delay; mean last24 and168 ending origin-2
nuisance: OLS projection of standardized D on standardized X plus intercept; fit only earlier training; not DML causal identification
residualization: after OLS, train-standardize residual D; std<1e-6 set feature zero; common occupancy ridge plus additional residual-D ridge
alpha_selection: per system, minimum rolling macro clipped RMSE among alphas with macro MAE no worse than native and maximum cell RMSE degradation <=1%; zero is fallback, not improvement
permutation: global zone derangement seed44, fixed across training and holdouts
information_gate: orthogonal_duration selected alpha>0; >=1% macro RMSE gain over best native/bias/occupancy/duplicate; MAE no worse; max cell RMSE degradation<=1%; positive mean gain in >=2 of3 rolling windows; beats permuted_orthogonal in macro RMSE with no worse MAE
mechanism_gate: separate >=1% RMSE gain with no worse MAE over selected raw_duration; not conflated with information gate
stage_two: only if information gate passes; then load prefix1966, freeze selected alphas, refit on training below1747 and evaluate every validation origin; no further selection
stage_two_gate: same1%/MAE/cell criterion vs best fixed non-duration control, plus permuted control; report raw-duration mechanism comparison separately
bootstrap: 2000 paired circular block resamples per rolling window over origins, block2 for stride12; all regions and horizon steps retained; descriptive after alpha selection, not a valid postselection confidence guarantee
read_boundary: stage one reads only1747 rows; stage two validation not read unless information gate passes; fold-three test never loaded
exposure: earlier-fold test timestamps enter expanding training; historical project exposure precludes globally blind claims
